title: fix(console): settings text boxes clear to unset; Reset to default beside Overrides
body:
Fixes #13145
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Settings pages (Setup, Configuration) can now take a value back to unset, and an override back to the inherited value. No server change: the settings door already reads `{"key": null}` as "clear this layer's value" (measured on the card).

- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`
  - An emptied text-like box (text, email, url, phone, password, textarea, and the free-text box of a `valueDomain` select) now puts `null` in the draft, never `""` (helper `textOrUnset`). The number control already did this and is unchanged. The closed Radix select cannot be emptied, so it is unchanged.
  - A row whose source badge reads "Overrides" (`console.settingsView.sourceBadgeOverrides`) shows one small "Reset to default" button beside the badge. It calls the row's `onChange(null)`: the key goes into the draft as `null`, the page turns dirty, and the existing Save sends it. After the save the badge is whatever the server's read-back for that row says. The client sets no source state of its own. The badge choice moved from `InheritanceBadges` into `sourceBadgeOf` (pure, same rules) so the header can tell an Overrides row from the rest. The button hides once the draft already holds `null` for that key, and it is disabled while saving.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: `console.settingsView.resetToDefault` in all ten packs.
- `.changeset/13145-settings-unset-and-reset.md`: patch for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

The API client was re-read: `saveSettingsNamespace` sends `JSON.stringify(patch)`, which keeps `null` values (only `undefined` is dropped). The new pins read the PUT body as it leaves `fetch`, so a dropped `null` would turn them red.

## Pins

New `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.unsetAndReset-13145.test.tsx`. It drives the whole page over a stubbed `fetch` through the real `../api`:
- (a) clearing a text field and saving sends exactly `{"smtp_host":null}`. A cleared password box sends `{"smtp_password":null}`.
- (b) "Reset to default" on an Overrides row sends `{"default_country":null}`. The row then shows the server answer's "Inherited from" badge, with no Overrides badge and no reset button.
- (c) CONTROLS: a typed value still sends the string. The number control sends `2525` as a number. An Inherited row and an unbadged row offer no reset, and the page has exactly one reset button.

`SettingsField.sourceBadgeLocale-12694.test.tsx`: the badge matcher now skips text inside a `button`. The zh copy of the new action ("恢复默认") contains the default layer's word, so the matcher would otherwise count it as a second badge. The badge assertions are unchanged.

## Ablations (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrapped and restored)

1. `return raw === '' ? null : raw;` replaced with `return raw;`. Result: the (a) cases go red: "a cleared text field is sent as null" and "a cleared password box is sent as null". `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`. Restore: blob f98737e29511 == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. The reset render guarded with `false &&`. Result: (b) goes red, and so does the CONTROL's "exactly one reset" count. `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`. Restore: blob f98737e29511 == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification (head 70c30d495f)

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0. The console's tsconfig includes `src`, so it covers the tests.
- vitest `apps/console/src/pages/settings/`: 22 files, 180 tests passed. Ran at the final head.
- vitest `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` plus the app-shell product-neutral ratchet: passed, at ed7baec5cc. The later commit touched only the badge-pin test.
- eslint on the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files, as the package `lint` scripts run it: 0 errors. Type-aware linting is not configured, so these files cannot move the verdict on files they do not touch. With `--no-inline-config`, one `react-hooks/static-components` error shows on an existing, already-disabled line that this PR does not touch. The base version shows the same error.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- Declared to CI, not run in full locally: the whole `apps/console` and `packages/i18n` test directories, and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- After a reset, the badge follows the server's `cascadeChain`. If only the manifest default is left, the effective scope is `default`. Today's badge rules draw no badge for that case, not an "Inherited" one. This PR does not change those rules.
- Password: the box never shows the stored secret. Typing into it and then emptying it now sends `null`, which clears the stored secret. Before this PR it sent `""`. Per the ruling, emptied means unset.
- The `color` row's hex text box and the `json` textarea still send what is typed. They are outside the ruling's text-like list.
